staged_social_media.csv: Social media odds ratio (more than once an hour vs non-users) and 2025 score as information is added in stages; both outcomes, with and without survey weights. lo/hi = 95% bootstrap range.
model_ladder.csv: Five tuned models: 2023 cross-validated AUROC, 2025 test AUROC, recall, precision, F1 at a 0.5 cutoff.
stronger_models.csv: Gradient boosting and averaging versus logistic regression, 2025 AUROC with ranges; share sad in the top 10% by risk.
shap_importance.csv: SHAP importance (mean |SHAP|, log-odds) for every question, boosting and logistic regression, with ranks.
question_ranking.csv: RFE rank and LASSO weight for every question.
selection_stability.csv: Share of 40 resamples in which each question made the RFE top 10 / short LASSO list.
rfe_curve.csv: Prediction score versus number of questions kept by RFE.
fairness_2025.csv: 2025 AUROC, recall and false-alarm rate by sex and race/ethnicity.
cutoffs_2025.csv: One cutoff versus separate cutoffs for girls and boys: share of sad students caught, false alarms.
profiles_kmeans.csv: Five k-means profiles: share of students and sad rate in 2023 and 2025, plus social media use inside each.
profiles_hierarchical_vs_kmeans.csv: Ward hierarchical clustering versus k-means: share and sad rate per group, both years.
risk_only_groups.csv: Groups built from risk questions only: share and sad rate in 2023 and 2025.
protective_factors.csv: Social media odds ratio with and without each protective factor (sleep, school closeness, activity, sports, parental monitoring).
calibration_2025.csv: Predicted versus actual sad rate in each tenth of 2025 students by risk.
single_question_scores.csv: 2025 AUROC of each question used alone.
codebook_check_2025.txt: Checks of the 2025 file against CDC's 2025 Data User's Guide.
